# Security / Safe Disclosure Guidance

This public repository is limited to non-confidential, high-level materials.

Do **not** include confidential implementation details, raw simulator inputs, calibration data, device parameters, layouts, process information, or manufacturing know-how in public issues, pull requests, discussions, or comments.

If you want to discuss technical evaluation, due diligence, licensing, acquisition, or investment matters, request a private contact channel through the repository owner first. Any further exchange of non-public information may require prior written permission and a separate confidentiality agreement.
